docRequirement: output-styles.md:17 makes **Default** "the existing system prompt", and :19 binds the product to "three additional built-in output styles": **Proactive** (:21 — "Claude executes immediately, makes reasonable assumptions instead of pausing for routine decisions, and prefers action over planning", explicitly "stronger autonomous-execution guidance than auto mode" and one that "works without changing your permission mode, so you still see permission prompts before tools run"), **Explanatory** (:23 — educational "Insights" interleaved with the work) and **Learning** (:25 — collaborative learn-by-doing that shares "Insights" and "will add `TODO(human)` markers in your code for you to implement"). The set is named, so a user or a doc-following config that asks for `Proactive` or `Learning` must get that style.
current: Our built-in set is four entries — `default`/Default, `concise`/Concise, `explanatory`/Explanatory, `reviewer`/Reviewer — declared in `BUILTIN_OUTPUT_STYLE_DEFINITIONS` at packages/shared/src/prompts/output-styles.ts:83-128 (default :85-91, concise :92-103, explanatory :104-115, reviewer :116-127), all with `keepCodingInstructions: true`. That array is the whole built-in surface: :130 derives `BUILTIN_OUTPUT_STYLE_IDS` from it, which is the accept-set of `isValidOutputStyleId` (:150-174, builtin branch :156-158); :518-524 `listOutputStyles` prepends it to the picker; :526-531 `resolveOutputStyle` matches a built-in id before any custom or plugin lookup. Neither `proactive` nor `learning` exists anywhere: `grep -ran` over `packages/` and `apps/` (excluding node_modules and dist) finds no built-in with either id and no `TODO(human)` marker string at all — the single "proactive" hit is packages/codex-protocol/generated/MultiAgentMode.ts:11, an unrelated Codex `MultiAgentMode` enum in a sibling subsystem. No layer above supplies the missing styles: both backends compose OUR block and append it to the vendor preset rather than selecting a vendor built-in — claude-agent.ts:1244-1258 passes `getOutputStyleId()` into `getSystemPrompt` as `presetAppend`, and pi-agent.ts:6586-6609 does the same through `resolveChildOutputStyleId`; prompts/system.ts:438-452 resolves the composition and system.ts:745-746 renders `getSafetyAndEngineeringSections(...)` then `${outputStylePrompt}`. The selection itself is the app-global `config.json:outputStyleId` (config/storage.ts:57, getter :2508-2511, setter :2513-2529, validator validators.ts:149), exposed over RPC at packages/server-core/src/handlers/rpc/settings.ts:132-159 (`GET_OUTPUT_STYLE`, `SET_OUTPUT_STYLE` gated by `isValidOutputStyleId`, `LIST_OUTPUT_STYLES` at :148-159) and rendered by apps/electron/src/renderer/pages/settings/AiSettingsPage.tsx:1007-1025, which labels built-ins from `t('outputStyles.<id>.label', style.label)` against the eight keys at packages/shared/src/i18n/locales/en.json:931-938 and ru.json:935-942. The built-in list is pinned by test at packages/shared/src/prompts/__tests__/output-styles.test.ts:19-27, which asserts exactly `concise`, `explanatory`, `reviewer`.
divergence: Set composition, not mechanism. The output-style mechanism is fully built — discovery, frontmatter, trust-gated roots, plugin namespacing, `keep-coding-instructions` subtraction, prompt composition on both backends — and two of the four documented built-in names are simply missing from `BUILTIN_OUTPUT_STYLE_DEFINITIONS`: `Proactive` (an autonomy posture; we have no style-level equivalent, and the only nearby thing is the `auto` permission mode, which the same doc line calls weaker AND which changes permission gating that the doc says Proactive must not) and `Learning` (no collaborative style, and no `TODO(human)` marker convention anywhere in the repo). `Default` and `Explanatory` share the documented names; `Concise` and `Reviewer` are Nessy-authored extras with no Claude counterpart, which is an addition, not a defect. Explanatory's missing "Insights" convention is a distinct, already-registered row (deviation-register :226) and is NOT part of this delta. The consequence is narrower than the finding as originally filed: a user-authored `.md` DOES resolve, because `discoverCustomOutputStyles` (:465-508) is name-agnostic and registers any `.md` under a scanned root as `custom:<slug>`, so dropping `Proactive.md` into `~/.nessy-agent/output-styles` yields a working selectable style. `NO_OUTPUT_STYLE` (:562, returned at :570) is reached only by a stored `outputStyleId` that matches no built-in, plugin or custom style.

New entry 1: `{ id: 'proactive', kind: 'builtin', label: 'Proactive', description: 'Execute immediately and prefer action over planning.', prompt: [...], keepCodingInstructions: true }` with prompt prose paraphrasing output-styles.md:21 — execute immediately, make reasonable assumptions instead of pausing for routine decisions, prefer action over planning — and it must be prompt text ONLY: it must not touch permission mode or any gating, because :21 binds Proactive to work "without changing your permission mode, so you still see permission prompts before tools run". New entry 2: `{ id: 'learning', kind: 'builtin', label: 'Learning', description: 'Learn by doing: shared insights plus TODO(human) handoffs.', prompt: [...], keepCodingInstructions: true }`, whose prose must name the two documented conventions from :25 — share educational "Insights" while coding, and leave `TODO(human)` markers in the code at small strategic spots for the user to implement. Both keep `keepCodingInstructions: true`: they are variations on the coding default, and Claude's built-ins do not subtract the engineering half. The existing composition wrapper at :578-588 already prefixes the block with "unless it conflicts with higher-priority safety, project, or user instructions", and system.ts:745-746 emits the style AFTER `getSafetyAndEngineeringSections`, so the untagged safety bullet at system.ts:592 ("Be proactive on requested work, but avoid surprising broad or irreversible actions.") still outranks the Proactive prose — keep it that way and do not tag that bullet `coding: true` to make room.

blastRadius: All additive and inside one package's data array; no wire or schema change. Readers of the array: `BUILTIN_OUTPUT_STYLE_IDS` (output-styles.ts:130) → `isValidOutputStyleId` (:150-174), which is the guard on the `SET_OUTPUT_STYLE` RPC (packages/server-core/src/handlers/rpc/settings.ts:136-145) and on plugin-style ids (:451) — adding ids only widens the accept-set; `listOutputStyles` (:518-524) → settings.ts:148-159 → RPC channel `settings:listOutputStyles` (apps/electron/src/transport/channel-map.ts:174, asserted in apps/electron/src/shared/__tests__/ipc-channels.test.ts:276) → AiSettingsPage.tsx:685, 1007-1025, whose `OutputStyleOption[]` shape is unchanged, only two more rows; `resolveOutputStyle` (:526-543) → `resolveOutputStyleComposition` (:564-589) → prompts/system.ts:438-452 → `getNessyAssistantPrompt` (system.ts:663, style rendered at :745-746) → both backends (claude-agent.ts:1244-1258, pi-agent.ts:6586-6609). PERSISTENCE boundary, read-only for this change: `config.json:outputStyleId` (config/storage.ts:57, :2508-2529; validators.ts:149 accepts `z.unknown().optional()`), so no migration is needed for an ADD — but a rename of an existing id would silently orphan a stored selection, which is why the change list forbids one. Subagent behaviour comes free: `resolveChildOutputStyleId` (packages/shared/src/agent/child-session-scope.ts:27-32) already drops the style for a `named` child and keeps it for a fork, matching output-styles.md:104. Tests touched: packages/shared/src/prompts/__tests__/output-styles.test.ts (:19-27, :236); the i18n gates `lint:i18n:parity` and `lint:i18n:sorted`; packages/server-core/src/bootstrap/__tests__/safe-mode-capability-gate.test.ts:155 asserts an empty PLUGIN style list and is unaffected by built-ins.
userImpact: Settings → AI → Output style offers exactly four entries: Default, Concise, Explanatory, Reviewer. A user who read Claude Code's docs and looks for Proactive or Learning does not find either, and there is no built-in way to get an autonomy posture as a STYLE — the only adjacent control is switching the permission mode to `auto`, which output-styles.md:21 calls weaker guidance and which additionally stops prompting before tools run, so the user trades a voice change for a safety change they did not ask for. The learn-by-doing style and its `TODO(human)` handoff convention are entirely unavailable, so a user pairing with the agent to learn a codebase has no built-in mode for it. The workaround exists but is undiscoverable: hand-authoring `~/.nessy-agent/output-styles/Proactive.md` does produce a working, selectable `custom:proactive` style (output-styles.ts:465-508, user root always scanned at :221) — nothing in the UI says so, and the user has to write the prompt prose themselves.

Two things deliberately NOT claimed here: (1) Explanatory's missing "Insights" convention — output-styles.md:23 — is a separate registered row (deviation-register.md:226) and a separate fix; (2) the documented `outputStyle` SETTINGS key, per-project selection, managed-policy tier, nested project roots, session-start-only reads and the :101 mid-conversation style reminders are each their own already-registered rows in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-output-style-contract.md §6, none of which this spec addresses. One adjacent observation, outside this delta and unverified as a defect: `LIST_OUTPUT_STYLES` (settings.ts:148-159) passes only `workspaceRootPath` and `pluginStyles` to `listOutputStyles`, never `workingDirectory`/`projectTrusted`, so styles in a trusted project's own `.nessy-agent/output-styles` appear to be invisible in the picker even though `getSystemPrompt` would resolve them — that narrows the hand-authored workaround to the user and workspace roots and deserves its own check.
